title: Devi Das Ram Das Cold Storage v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following even-date order in connected batch.
headnote: A writ challenging demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed, with reasons to be read from the even-date order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. An earlier Division Bench had tagged the petition with Vehina Steels (WP 30582 of 2009) and restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders.
facts: Devi Das Ram Das Cold Storage and four others challenged a demand of additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The petition was tagged with Writ Petition No. 30582 of 2009 (Vehina Steels & Alloys v. PVVNL) and similar pending matters on the same issue. On 4 July 2013 the Court, following the interim order in that connected writ, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders. On 21 March 2017 a later Division Bench dismissed the writ.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging a demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed; reasons are those in the even-date order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. Until that dismissal, following the interim order in connected WP 30582 of 2009, the respondents had been restrained from demanding additional security.
